name: FA_INVENTORY_INT
description: This table stores physical inventory data used to run the asset physical inventory comparison.

columns.name: INVENTORY_NAME
columns.description: User entered physical inventory name.

columns.name: INVENTORY_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Identifier to process the distributions of the asset in a single transaction.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: UNIT_ADJ_CODE
columns.description: Change in units required to resolve the unit difference between the physical inventory and the asset book. Possible values are Increase, Decrease, or None.

columns.name: UNIT_DIFFERENCE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Transaction performed to resolve the unit difference between the physical inventory and the asset book.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Transaction number of the transaction that is created to resolve the difference between the physical inventory and asset book.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
